title: Pillars of Salah: opening takbir, standing and recitation
intro: The six parts of Salah – the first three.

learn.html: The pillars (arkan) of Salah are its essential parts. There are six, and we must do them all carefully and correctly for our Salah to be right and complete. Without all of them, Salah is not right and must be prayed again.

After the niyyah, boys raise their hands to their ears, fingers together, palms facing the Qiblah, touching the soft part of the ears with the thumbs, and say Allaahu akbar. Girls raise their hands to their chest, fingers together, and say Allaahu akbar. We look at the place of sajdah. The feet face the Qiblah, four fingers apart.

We stand straight and look at the place where our face goes down in sajdah. Boys put their hands at the waist, right hand over left, holding the left wrist with the thumb and little finger. Girls hold their hands on the chest, the right palm on the back of the left hand.
Standing, we recite what is set for each standing. In the first standing: Subhanaka, A‘udhu billah, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah. In the second standing: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Standing + recitation + ruku‘ + sajdah + sajdah = one rak‘ah. A Salah can have two, three or four rak‘ahs.
